wheelSpeedBuffer.consumerBehavior: GLAvmAPI accepts status bytes8..11 all zero, decodes four signed16 big-endian values from bytes0..7, multiplies each by0.06875*1000/3.6 and passes them to renderer event15.
wheelSpeedBuffer.inference: The arithmetic is consistent with 0.06875 km/h raw units converted to mm/s; physical units and wheel order are not qualified on this car.
limits: GLAvmAPI is one panorama implementation; its selection on this vehicle is unproved.
Preserve exact raw bytes/status and validate length before using this candidate decoder.
The direction consumer has overlapping byte windows and is not accepted as a reliable decoder.
Selectors1/2 are SDK buffer selectors, not UDS services or the scalar FIDs.
SDK uses eight two-byte records; scalar methods enumerate nine areas. Do not unify the layouts without runtime evidence.
RSE/RCS paths strip a four-byte prefix; IVI applicability must remain explicit.
Do not replay native transact10/12 with scalar-only parcels; earlier such calls crashed autoservice.

criticalNamespaceFinding.meaning: A DiCar property key is resolved by name to the runtime BYDAutoFeatureIds field. Its displayed hex is not always the native FID. Never pass unverified property-key hex directly to autoservice.

faultEnums.3: TC_FAILURE (do not expand abbreviation without evidence)

limits: These are read paths in the owner firmware, not proof all sensor hardware is installed or all values answer.
No diagnostic ECU owns these FIDs merely because its name describes the same function.
Integer device IDs, DiCar property keys, native FIDs, CAN addresses and UDS DIDs are distinct namespaces.
No unsupported field is interpreted as zero, healthy or absent hardware.
